articles.title: Contract awarded to ITI Ltd. for printing licences, RCs followed due tender procedures, Kerala High Court told
articles.description: Kerala government confirms ITI Limited won the licence-printing contract through due tender procedures, in a case linked to Transport Commissioner S. Sreejith.

articles.title: Central Asia Pushes Ahead With Regional Electricity Market
articles.description: Central Asian officials are pursuing a pilot project to create a more efficient regional electricity distribution system. According to a statement issued by Kazakhstan’s state-run electric company, KEGOC, a World Bank-supported tender seeks to attract an international firm to develop and oversee a 24-month project to establish a spot electricity market for four Central Asian states – Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan. The project would involve the creation of a “trading platform and settlement system.” Implementation…

articles.title: Offline tenders undermine transparency, fuel graft and revenue loss: Arappor warns CM Vijay
articles.description: Alleging that a recent Finance Department circular, exempting lower-value tenders from the online process, could open the door to corruption in government procurement, anti-corruption organisation Arappor Iyakkam has urged the State government to withdraw the order.
